about: Minecraft mode (0.2.0): every key New Vegas sees, by DirectInput scancode, with the SDL scancode Minecraft 26.3 uses. 'minecraft' keys go to Minecraft (New Vegas ignores them); 'newvegas' keys stay with New Vegas.
